description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategy class within the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests the behavior of command substitution logic, specifically focusing on how placeholders within policies and access control lists (ACLs) are replaced during processing.

classes.name: ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for Verify behavior of ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategy, ensuring placeholder substitution for policies and ACLs works correctly within the Eclipse Ditto context.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that instances of ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategy are immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderForPolicySubjectIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that command remains unchanged if no placeholders are present for policy subject ID.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoInlinePolicyIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that command remains unchanged if no inline policy is provided.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenInvalidInlinePolicyIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that command remains unchanged if an invalid inline policy is provided.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderForPolicySubjectIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that the command's policy substitutes the placeholder with the actual subject ID.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderForAclSubjectIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that the ACL's subject ID placeholder is replaced correctly during substitution.
